## Emergency Cyber Crime Reporting (Golden Hour Protocol)
If funds are unauthorizedly debited or someone is targeted by online fraud:
1. **Immediate Call (Golden Hour)**: Dial 1930 or contact bank fraud desk within 2 hours to freeze stolen money before ATM withdrawal.
2. **Preserve Evidence**: Save screenshots of transaction UTR numbers, WhatsApp chats, fake APK files, and phone logs.
3. **Register e-FIR**: File a formal financial fraud complaint on https://cybercrime.gov.in.
4. **Notify Bank Branch**: Submit complaint acknowledgement receipt to home bank branch within 24 hours to secure RBI zero-liability protection.

## Key 2026 Citizen Scam Defense Rules
- **Digital Arrest**: Indian law has NO concept of 'Digital Arrest'. Police, CBI, ED, and customs never conduct interrogations, court sessions, or arrests via video call.
- **WhatsApp Wedding Cards / Traffic Fines (APKs)**: Genuine wedding cards are images or PDFs; genuine traffic fines are viewed on echallan.parivahan.gov.in. Never install any file ending in .apk sent via chat or SMS.
- **Accidental UPI Transfer**: Never send money back directly via UPI. The incoming funds are stolen; sending money flags your account as a criminal mule. Direct the caller to their bank.
- **Fake IPO WhatsApp Groups**: SEBI-registered brokerages never conduct institutional IPO bidding or accept investments via WhatsApp groups or personal accounts.

## Top Curated AI Developer Tools
- [OpenAI Codex](https://openai.com/index/openai-codex/): AI code generation engine powering automated syntax completion, agentic logic, and test synthesis.
- [ECC](https://ecc.tools/): The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
- [headroom](https://docs.headroomlabs.ai/docs): Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
- [litellm](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/): The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthrop…
- [OmniRoute](https://omniroute.online/): Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 375 providers (150+ free), 1,400+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Clin…
- [supermemory](https://supermemory.ai/docs): Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
- [Amazon Q Developer / Kiro IDE](https://aws.amazon.com/q/developer/): AWS's generative AI coding assistant and spec-driven development environment for code transformation and security scanning.
- [Understand Anything](https://understand-anything.com/): Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI…
- [context mode](https://contextmode.ai/): Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/claude-code): Anthropic's terminal-based agentic coding tool that navigates codebases, edits files, and manages git commits autonomously.
- [cc switch](https://ccswitch.io/): A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more.
- [graphify](https://www.graphify.com/): Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing,…
- [openinterpreter](https://openinterpreter.com/): A coding agent for open models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3
- [next ai draw io](https://next-ai-drawio.jiang.jp/): Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with an AI. Web app, desktop app, and an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and VS Code.
- [OpenSpec](https://openspec.dev/): Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants.
- [code review graph](https://code-review-graph.com/): Local-first code intelligence graph for MCP and CLI. Builds a persistent map of your codebase so AI coding tools read only what matters, with benchmarked context reductions on reviews and large-repo…

- [Codewhale](https://codewhale.net/): Open-source agent for the terminal written in Rust. Use any provider or model. Issues & PRs always welcome
- [RTK (Rust Token Killer)](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk): CLI proxy that condenses command outputs by 60–90% to reduce LLM token consumption and API costs.
- [oh my openagent](https://omo.dev/): OmO: Just type "mass ulw" keyword with your prompt. Now you are the master of graph engineering.
- [Kimi Code](https://kimi.ai): Moonshot AI's long-context reasoning and coding model optimized for repository understanding and multi-file logic.

- [Cline](https://github.com/cline/cline): Autonomous coding agent inside VS Code with file editing, shell command execution, and browser interaction.
